item.title: U.S. regulators missed the July 18 GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules; the $310B market operates under proposed frameworks.
Senate Republicans released an updated CLARITY Act on July 22, moving the U.S. digital asset market-structure bill toward a floor vote.
The SEC is preparing to propose three crypto rules in July covering token-offering exemptions, broker-dealer custody, and trading venues.
Three DeFi protocols lost a combined $35M in July 23 exploits; AFX Trade on Arbitrum drained of $24M via compromised bridge keys.
Europe's MiCA compliance demands could trigger a crypto M&A wave as compliant banks gain acquisition advantages over smaller players.
BNY plans to test tokenized U.S. Treasury settlement on a private blockchain by year-end, targeting 24/7 settlement operations by 2027.
Morgan Stanley received preliminary OCC approval for a digital-asset trust bank to provide custody, staking, and collateral services.
Citigroup plans institutional bitcoin custody in 2026, enabling clients to hold bitcoin alongside traditional securities in one account.
SEC Commissioner Peirce warned that DeFi vaults and onchain lending may fall under U.S. securities laws depending on their structure.
Sberbank will launch a crypto trading and custody platform by December 2026, before Russia's new crypto rules take effect in September.
BlackRock amended its Coinbase custody agreement to require bitcoin withdrawals within 12 hours.
The CFTC warned prediction market firms that bulk contract submissions are insufficient and each contract must be individually evaluated.
Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring a sale or IPO with advisors Morgan Stanley and KBW.
Survey: 84% of financial institutions rank tokenization as a strategic priority and expect blockchain to reshape markets within five years.
